title: Summer schools & short programs
summary: Two to eight weeks of language, culture or business: try China without a long commitment.
overview: Short programs suit anyone who wants to test the country, improve Chinese or add international experience to a CV. Summer schools run at universities and language centres, with campus housing or independent accommodation.
They are also a good test before a bachelor's: you see the campus, city and pace. But a short program doesn't replace a language year and doesn't guarantee admission — it's a separate experience.
fitFor: You want a first experience of living in China
You're interested in language, culture or business
You have a limited budget and timeline
outcomes: A real sense of campus life
Material for a future motivation letter

timeline.text: We choose the program, dates and city for your budget.
Application, place confirmation, payment and invitation.
A briefing on campus and your first days.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for a summer school?
faq.answer: It depends on the length and format. Short programs sometimes work on a tourist or business visa; longer ones need a student visa. We check the university and consulate requirements for your dates.
